usefulness.rationale: The dossier contains no extracted content: only three identity anchors (birth date/place, role as chairman-CEO of VINCI since 2010, education at École polytechnique and Ponts et Chaussées) and one reference excerpt. A reader learns the bare outline of who he is but nothing about what he actually did — no career narrative, actions, or achievements. The dossier never states what it does not know, implying completeness it cannot support, so remainingQuestions scores 0. A reader could not prepare for a substantive meeting beyond knowing his title and background. No claims with citations exist in the dossier, so no verifiable overclaims can be flagged; the listed unjustified conclusions concern statements not present in the dossier, so no match could be confirmed.
